boundedProgress.result: Fresh September 2026 Mobilithek-derived evidence at Am Geismartor AC again confirms 1.50 EUR start fee and 0.06 EUR/min blocking after 240 minutes for direct AC. Current first-party registered Basistarif remains separate and is not substituted. DC/HPC anonymous fee completeness remains unresolved.
